description: Demolition of an existing garage and construction of a 1 x 3 storey single family dwelling and 1 x 3 storey building to provide 2 x self-contained flats with associated cycle and refuse and recycling stores and external plant (AHSP); and the construction of a lift on the rear elevation of Fanshaw House and enlargement of ground floor windows on the rear elevation of Fanshaw House.
decision_conditions: <p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to commencing the works, for each section of the development or stage in the development - as may be agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (LPA) - a scheme including the following components to address the risks associated with site contamination shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the LPA.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">a) A preliminary risk assessment which identifies all previous uses, potential contaminants associated with those uses (including asbestos, landfill gas, vapours and ground water contaminants); a conceptual model of the site indicating sources, pathways and receptors; and potentially unacceptable risks arising from contamination at the site;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">b) A generic and detailed quantitative risk assessment based on (a) that identifies the risk to all receptors potentially affected, including those off site;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">c) In the event that remediation measures are deemed necessary following the results of (b), an options appraisal identifying feasible remediation options, detailing evaluation of options, and selecting the most appropriate remediation option(s);&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">d) A remediation strategy focused on the remediation option(s) selected in (c) setting site specific monitoring objectives and criteria, providing details of monitoring and maintenance, and containing full details of the remediation measures required, and how they are to be undertaken.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">e) A verification plan explaining how the effectiveness of the remediation works set out in (d) will be measured, and how data will be collected and assessed to demonstrate that the remediation objectives and criteria will be met.&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">f) A verification report demonstrating that remediation objectives and criteria identified in (e) have been met, assessing the remediation performance, and creating a final record of the land quality whilst providing a plan for long term monitoring and maintenance (if required).&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Any investigation and risk assessment must be undertaken in strict accordance with the requirements of the Environment Agency’s Land Contamination Risk Management (LCRM). If additional significant contamination is found at any time when carrying out the approved development, it must immediately be reported in writing to the LPA.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">For the avoidance of doubt, this condition can be discharged on a section by section basis.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON:&nbsp;</span>To protect human health and the environment by ensuring no harm is caused by land&nbsp;<span class="il" style="">contamination</span>, in line with paragraphs H, I and J, LP 58 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033.</p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-a333d964-7fff-88ba-fc78-2439e3c1e968"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to any above ground works associated with the construction phase of the development, full details, with samples, of the materials to be used on the external surfaces of the buildings, including glazing and all boundary treatments, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before any above ground work on the site is commenced. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-fa2a2fd5-7fff-14ce-5b22-96b1fc3f9020"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that the external appearance of the building is satisfactory and does not detract from the character and visual amenity of the area. These details are required prior to commencement of any above ground works as they are integral to the fabric of the development and cannot therefore be dealt with retrospectively.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Detailed drawings/full particulars of the proposed development showing the matters set out below must be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority, in writing, before work on the relevant part of the development commences. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">1) Typical window and door details including sections at 1:20;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">2) 1:20 drawings of all boundary treatments (including timber bollards and planters).&nbsp;</span></p><p><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure a satisfactory external appearance.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">A Construction Management Plan (CMP) specifying hours of working, construction traffic routing, measures to prevent dust pollution and contact arrangements between residents and contractors shall be submitted and agreed by the Local Planning Authority Prior to the commencement of the development. The construction logistics plan shall include the following details:&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">(a) loading and unloading of plant and materials;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">(b) storage of plant and materials;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">(c) programme of works (including measures for traffic management);&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">(d) provision of boundary hoarding behind any visibility zones;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">(e) wheel cleaning provision on site. Construction shall thereafter take place in accordance with the measures identified within the CMP.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b1cf98fa-7fff-c65c-cf7d-df3c773680f4"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that during demolition and construction works that there would be no negative amenity or highway impacts as a result of the development. These details are required prior to commencement as they affect the entirety of the construction phase and cannot, therefore, be dealt with retrospectively.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">No non-road mobile machinery (NRMM) shall be used on the site unless it is compliant with the NRMM Low Emission Zone requirements (or any superseding requirements) and until it has been registered for use on the site on the NRMM register (or any superseding register).&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-0731aad8-7fff-5df9-8f6d-527016f3febc"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that air quality is not adversely affected by the development in line with Policy SI 1 of the London Plan (2021) and the Mayor's The Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition SPG (2014).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the commencement of the relevant part of the work, the applicant shall submit, and have approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, a detailed layout, cross sections (scale 1:20), full specifications and a detailed management and maintenance plan of the biodiverse roof with a minimum substrate depth of 80mm, not including the vegetative mat. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved and shall be fully implemented before the premises are first occupied.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-177126c4-7fff-fc97-ca83-b5b159f69af1"><br><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">To promote biodiversity on site in line with policy LP46 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">All areas labelled as 'green roof' on the drawings hereby approved shall not be used for any purpose other than as a means of escape in emergency or for maintenance of the building. In particular the areas shall not be used as a roof terrace, balcony or any other amenity area.&nbsp;</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-5b5cb0b3-7fff-84b0-592e-4707d7190b0e"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To safeguard the amenities of the adjoining premises and the area generally.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The noise level from all plant and machinery included in the approved development shall at all times remain 10dB(A) below background levels when measured at any nearby residential window.</span></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-24ba2957-7fff-e04b-5967-3593b7a86072"><br></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure that occupiers of neighbouring premises do not suffer a loss of amenity by reason of noise nuisance and other excess noise.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, notwithstanding the details as shown on the approved drawings, precise details of the proposed cycle parking provision which is safe, secure and accessible for all shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details and thereafter retained solely for its designated use.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 35.4331pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-c2085281-7fff-6d5d-8519-d0efc3ec83d1"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 35.4331pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure adequate provision for the safe and secure storage of bicycles, to promote sustainable modes of transport and in the interest of safeguarding highway safety in accordance with Policy LP42 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, notwithstanding the details as shown on the approved drawings, precise details of the proposed refuse and recycling storage capacity shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall thereafter be carried out in strict accordance with the approved details and the area shall remain free from obstruction other than for its approved use.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-11abc2d7-7fff-afc9-9308-5ce820c330a2"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: To ensure adequate provision for refuse and recycling is provided which would safeguard the amenity of the area and not compromise pedestrian safety.</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details must be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority to demonstrate at least the consented standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">a) Minimum Heat pump Coefficient of Performance of 2.28&nbsp;&nbsp;</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">b) Minimum Heat pump Seasonal Coefficient of Performance of 3.45</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">c) Details of location of the condenser units from the heat pump systems and any noise solutions to mitigate the impact for nearby sensitive receptors.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b0bc55db-7fff-45da-5a3f-30bb10fa0bb5"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction, in accordance with LP54 and LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan and SI2 and SI4 of the London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the occupation of the development hereby approved, details must be submitted to and approved by the Local Authority to demonstrate at least the consented standards have been met, as set out in the hereby approved Energy Statement for providing a minimum MVRH exchange rate of 0.5ac/h in habitable rooms.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-b508865e-7fff-953e-7ab6-e2badc6a3c34"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: In the interest of addressing climate change and securing sustainable and net zero development and construction, in accordance with LP54 and LP55 of the Hackney Local Plan and SI2 and SI4 of the London Plan (2021).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby approved, the applicant shall provide a statement to confirm that the development has been designed to be water efficient and reduce water&nbsp; consumption as far as possible, demonstrating that the development will not exceed a maximum water use of 105 litres of water per person per day, with an additional maximum water use allowance for external water consumption of 5 litres.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-88602d8e-7fff-e9e6-9f93-8edf5d367c5a"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: Addressing the need to conserve water, to mitigate and adapt to climate change, taking into account the full range of potential climate change impacts in accordance with the London Plan (2021), Hackney Local Plan (2020) and the National Planning Policy Framework (2024).</span></p>

<p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The development hereby approved shall provide two swift boxes close to the eaves prior to first occupation and shall be retained as such in perpetuity.</span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height: 1.38; margin-left: 36pt; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt;"><br></p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-19ce5c69-7fff-4fd0-2f5d-12c6ba418e3b"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">REASON: </span><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">To promote biodiversity on site in line with policy LP46 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020).</span></span></p>
